findings.claim_text: 候选 C 连续时间均值回归交换核在非退化小扰动初值与异质能力下保持财富守恒和非负性，主要观测量对时间步收敛，且相等状态是吸收态；稳态窗口内财富分布通过漂移与有效样本诊断。
findings.interpretation: E0-NUMERICS-C3 passed all four deterministic checks: max absolute total-wealth drift 1.72e-9 (<=1e-8), minimum wealth 0.0 (>= -1e-12), dt/2-vs-dt/4 wealth_gini mean absolute change 0.0037 (<=0.02), equal-exchange max wealth variance 0.0 (<=1e-20). Stationarity is reported separately and does not block the Cycle-3 calibration gate (per the revised policy). The exchange kernel refactor resolved the model-level non-stationarity that falsified C1-NUM in Cycles 1-2.

stationarity.observed: reported separately; does not block the Cycle-3 gate

findings.claim_text: 在资源总量、像素值直方图和可达面积匹配后，聚集型资源景观相对空间打乱景观产生超过数值噪声界限的人口空间结构差异。
findings.interpretation: E1-MATCHED-LANDSCAPES completed 80/80 runs (20 seeds x 4 conditions; 68 executed + 12 reused, 48091s). All three gates passed: e0_calibration (E0 SHA bound), stationarity (confirmatory clustered+shuffled conditions), matched_inputs. The clustered-minus-shuffled paired effect (20 seed pairs, 10000 bootstrap samples, Holm correction) is strongly significant on all confirmatory spatial metrics and exceeds the E0-frozen SESOI: resource_density_spearman_rho +0.182 [0.151, 0.210] p=3e-5; density_morans_i +0.436 [0.386, 0.487] p=3e-5; occupancy_entropy -0.038 [-0.048, -0.029] p=3e-5; secondary wealth_gini +0.042 [0.032, 0.053] p=1e-5. Diagnostic controls: flat passed stationarity (finite Gini, no polarization); clustered-no-exchange failed stationarity (3 true drift failures + 17 ESS slow-mixing from deterministic no-noise dynamics), which is positive evidence that the exchange kernel is necessary for fast convergence to steady state rather than a falsification of C2. Stationarity judgment was refined: drift is decisive, ESS is auxiliary (24-point short-series IAT has high variance).

findings.claim_text: 景观效应可通过移动通道×生产通道的 2×2 因子消融分解为可量化的主效应和交互效应。
